notes.title: Tick Tock Isle joins the Time Travel Bundle!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/9252/Time_Travel_Bundle/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10877516/baba3ae5af538047134fd5babbf6182b3e1ca96d.png[/img][/url]

Greetings, curious adventurers and daring pioneers! Tick Tock Isle has joined a group of amazing games in the new time travel bundle!

The doors have opened to times long gone and strange worlds long forgotten. Or would you rather see into the future and find out what awaits humanity? That is also part of this journey. 

Seven amazing experiences are waiting for you in the Time Travel bundle. Take a look:
[list]
[*] Odysseus Kosmos and his Robot Quest
[*] Stories: The Path of Destinies
[*] The Inner World
[*] Omensight
[*] Chronology
[*] Pankapu
[*] [b]Tick Tock Isle[/b]
[/list]
We have combined games from different genres and styles, yet united by the theme of time travel to remind you how diverse the experience can be. 

You will rely on intelligence and cunning to solve challenging riddles. Other times, combining skill and blunt force is the only way to protect what is dear to you. And when that doesn’t work, going back through a time loop over and over again may shine light on the right path. 

Conquer time and space in a whirlpool of worlds so unlike each other!
